name: PT Bahtera Bumi Raya Tbk
summary: PT Bahtera Bumi Raya Tbk operates as a shipping and resource integration platform in Indonesia. The company operates in two segments, Travel Services and Shipping Services. It provides flight ticket, travel tour package, event, train ticket, shipping, and other services. The company also engages in the travel agency and tour operator; logistics management and nickel ore transportation; domestic sea transportation for general cargo, special cargo, and shipping services for remote areas; nickel ore and coal trading; and contractor for nickel, coal, gold, and other minerals.
